headline: Andoni Iraola: Alexander Isak will 'produce the numbers' at Liverpool
description: Andoni Iraola has no doubt that Liverpool's £125 million ($170m) forward Alexander Isak will "produce the numbers" this season after a brace inside nine minutes inspired a 2-0 win at Ipswich.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Will Chelsea's Neto leave in January?

headline: Premier League recap: Isak's brace vs. Ipswich gives Liverpool first win of the season
description: Enjoy all that happened from Portman Road as Liverpool defeated Ipswich Town 2-0 for their first win of the Premier League season.

headline: Liverpool ratings: With 9/10 performance, is Isak's big breakout coming?
description: Alexander Isak disappointed after his record transfer fee last summer, but he was Liverpool's best player at Ipswich on Friday.

headline: Richarlison declined new contract months before Tottenham squad omission - Roberto De Zerbi
description: Roberto De Zerbi has revealed that he was happy for Richarlison to sign an extension to his Tottenham contract, but the now exiled player declined.
